title: Data Processing Inequality for sandwiched Rényi divergence (α > 1) via Stinespring purification
intent: Reduce the Data Processing Inequality `D̃_ α(Φ ρ‖Φ σ) ≤ D̃_ α(ρ‖σ)` for an arbitrary CPTP map `Φ` to a six-link calculational chain: first dilate `Φ` into ancilla preparation + unitary conjugation + partial trace (Stinespring), then rewrite the target step by step with a named lemma per link — two purification lemmas plus one lemma each for tensor-with-pure-ancilla, monotonicity under partial trace, unitary invariance, and dropping the ancilla.

children.name: prep_append_eq_tensor_pure
children.statement:
theorem prep_append_eq_tensor_pure [Inhabited d₂] (ρ : MState d₁) :
    let ψ₀ : Ket (d₂ × d₂) := Ket.basis default
    let τ := MState.pure ψ₀
    let zero_prep : CPTPMap Unit (d₂ × d₂) := CPTPMap.replacement τ
    let prep := (CPTPMap.id ⊗ᶜᵖ zero_prep)
    let append : CPTPMap d₁ (d₁ × Unit) := CPTPMap.ofEquiv (Equiv.prodPUnit d₁).symm
    (prep ∘ₘ append) ρ = ρ ⊗ᴹ τ
children.note: Helper the author flagged to be pulled out to a more reasonable place (comment "PULLOUT to a more reasonable place"). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Preparing a fixed pure state and appending equals tensoring with that pure state.

children.name: sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceLeft
children.statement:
theorem sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceLeft [Nonempty dA]
    (hα : 1 < α) (ρ σ : MState (dA × dB)) :
    D̃_ α(ρ.traceLeft‖σ.traceLeft) ≤ D̃_ α(ρ‖σ)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The sandwiched Rényi divergence is monotone under traceLeft for α > 1.

lemma sandwichedRenyiEntropy_conj_unitary (hα : 0 < α) (ρ σ : MState d)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup d ℂ) :
    D̃_ α(ρ.uConj U‖σ.uConj U) = D̃_ α(ρ‖σ)

children.name: sandwichedRenyiEntropy_tensor_pure
children.statement:
lemma sandwichedRenyiEntropy_tensor_pure (hα : 0 < α) (ρ σ : MState d₁) (ψ : Ket d₂) :
    D̃_ α(ρ ⊗ᴹ MState.pure ψ‖σ ⊗ᴹ MState.pure ψ) = D̃_ α(ρ‖σ)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The sandwiched Rényi divergence is invariant under tensoring with a fixed pure state.

applicability.goal_shape: An inequality (or equality) between two instances of an order-respecting quantity `D̃_ α(Φ ρ‖Φ σ) ≤ D̃_ α(ρ‖σ)`, to be closed by rewriting the target through an intermediate normal form so that each link is a previously proved invariance or monotonicity lemma.
applicability.use_when: The map `Φ` has a representation theorem (here Stinespring: ancilla preparation + unitary + partial trace) that lets you pass the target through a chain of equalities and `≤` steps, and each step is already a named lemma whose own proof is a leaf.
applicability.avoid_when: The steps are not already named lemmas (an inline calc hides the skeleton the move is meant to expose), or a link needs the wrong monotonicity direction (`≥`), which a calc chain does not compose by default (survey F §10 rule 9).

claims.claim: The parent `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_DPI_gt_one` is declared in `QuantumInfo/Entropy/DPI.lean` within lines 1349-1378.

The authors state the reduction in the doc comment above the theorem: "The proof uses the Stinespring representation (see `CPTPMap.exists_purify`): every CPTP map can be written as ancilla preparation + unitary conjugation + partial trace. Since the sandwiched Rényi divergence is invariant under the first two operations (by additivity and relabel invariance) and monotone under partial trace (by `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceRight`), the DPI follows."

Five project lemmas sit in a chain below the parent: `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceLeft` (line 1314) is closed by `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceRight'` (cited at line 1321), which uses `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceRight` (line 1306), which uses `sandwichedTraceFunctional_mono_traceRight` (line 1222), which uses `sandwichedTraceFunctional_jointly_convex` (line 1110); all in `QuantumInfo/Entropy/DPI.lean`.
The parent site is 30 lines long.

consequences: Each link of the calc is an `=` or `≤` whose justification is one named lemma, so transitivity is discharged by the chain itself and the only obligations are the hypotheses of each lemma (`hα : 1 < α`, `0 < α`, and the `Nonempty`/`Inhabited` instances). Failure modes: a link with the wrong monotonicity direction (`≥`) does not compose (survey F §10 rule 9); steps 3 and 4 reuse the same `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceLeft` with a `..` hole, so the second trace must be dropped in exactly the right order; and the kernel condition of the trace-functional monotonicity is hidden inside `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceLeft`, which dispatches it via `by_cases` in `sandwichedRenyiEntropy_mono_traceRight'`.
